title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if we could train models that reason like humans, but with the precision of machines? How will this reshape our future?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses Cascade RL and on-policy distillation, enabling 30B MoE models to reason across domains with high efficiency and performance.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But with such power comes risk — who controls these models? Could they be weaponized or used to manipulate public opinion at scale?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are prioritizing transparency and open-source frameworks, ensuring accountability and enabling community-driven safety checks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where AI helps solve climate crises, democratizes education, and enhances creativity — but only if we guide it responsibly.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about capability — it’s about how we shape the evolution of intelligence, together.
